message:
# Meridian T2 delivered with one verification gap

Saved the complete handover in [FINAL.md](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w14/FINAL.md). The implementation and production build are retained in `app/` and `app/dist/`, together with the original failures, research, captures, and decision records.

## What changed

- **Recognizable attachments.** Documents now use the supplied assistant-ui File components, with persistent filename text and a “Filename only” label. A supplied Dialog exposes the complete long filename and explains that contents are never read or uploaded. The attachment band stays one row; keyboard focus reveals the whole active chip. Removal returns focus to the composer.
- **Bounded input growth.** The original single-line composer remains 94 px tall. The textarea retains its 192 px ceiling in taller views and is capped at 152 px at 1280 × 600, preserving six 24 px lines plus padding. With four filenames and a long draft, the compact composer measures 260 px rather than the baseline’s 310 px, leaving **50 px more reading space**.
- **Reading continuity.** The viewport uses assistant-ui’s supported bottom-anchor configuration with `scroll-auto`. An initial smooth-scroll trial visibly lost the reader’s position after a long question; both the main designer and independent challenger reproduced it. Immediate positioning fixed that measured condition while preserving the source controller’s manual pause and explicit return behavior.
- **Stop and recovery.** Text smoothing remains enabled during generation and flushes already-received text when the runtime stops, avoiding a lingering typewriter tail. Stop restores input focus without scrolling. Retry/regenerate wording and the main composer/file controls have English and Chinese labels.
- **Build compatibility.** Removed TypeScript 7’s obsolete `baseUrl` option and included Vite’s CSS import types. Dependencies and the lockfile remain unchanged.

The source family, integration responsibilities, alternatives, and consequential revisions are recorded in [SPEC.md](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w14/SPEC.md).

## Verification

The **1440 × 900, 1280 × 600, and 390 × 844** conditions were exercised in light/English and dark/Chinese. I personally inspected all six final populated composer captures. Checks covered one-line, six-line, and long input; four filenames; full-name disclosure; Escape return; complete focused-chip visibility; removal focus; and absence of horizontal page overflow.

The corrected focused episode run passed **21 assertions** covering Shift+Enter, streaming, manual scroll-away, return while content grows, a second upward scroll, Stop stability and focus, deliberate failure/retry through the full seven-theme answer, repeated questions, Escape cancellation, and reduced motion.

The earlier broader run completed **80 assertions without assertion failures**, but stopped when the Chinese response finished before its Stop step. That timing error and a subsequent script extraction error remain preserved. The corrected episode run completed successfully.

TypeScript and the final production build pass. The build retains a large-bundle warning—approximately **1.29 MB JavaScript, 392 KB gzip**. Device performance was not benchmarked.

Evidence and inspection scope:

- [VISUAL-REVIEW.md](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w14/VISUAL-REVIEW.md)
- [Six-condition browser results](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w14/evidence/final/events.json)
- [Corrected focused episode results](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w14/evidence/final3/events.json)
- [Independent challenger report](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w14/evidence/challenger/REPORT.md)

## Remaining verification gap

The final narrow-screen edit/update probe timed out locating the upstream Edit control after cancellation. **It did not establish a product defect or a successful edit path.** Editing remains inherited and needs a fresh affordance-level check.

A filename-dialog capture taken after 250 ms exists, but I did not personally open it before the substantive time bound. I viewed its earlier entry-state capture. The visual review distinguishes these observations and does not claim natural-time playback.

This remains the specified in-memory synthetic application: no real model service, file-content upload, or persistent remote history. Some unchanged upstream shell labels remain English in the Chinese condition. Browser checks used Chromium 143 and viewport emulation; native mobile keyboards, touch, screen readers, other engines, and device performance remain unverified.

## Run and review

The owned preview has been stopped. Restart it with:

```bash
cd /workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w14/app
npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4414
```

Then open either:

- `http://127.0.0.1:4414/?theme=light&lang=en`
- `http://127.0.0.1:4414/?theme=dark&lang=zh`

To serve the production build from the same directory:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 4414 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory dist
```

## Delegation and timing preservation

Both research-only children completed; I retained product design, implementation, and final inspection responsibility. [DELEGATION.json](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w14/DELEGATION.json) records the actual requests and returned identities.

The research child’s **original final notification body** is preserved separately from its report copy in [research-final-notification.md](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w14/evidence/coordination/research-final-notification.md). Its opening delivery sentence and original citation references remain intact. [Separate metadata](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w14/evidence/coordination/research-final-notification-metadata.json) records the sender, `/root/product_14_final/composer_research`, without inventing a receipt timestamp or backend telemetry.

The recorded product-work close is **2026-11-01T11:52:55.436367Z**, **3.294 seconds after** the conservative 30-minute boundary. That overrun is preserved without backdating in [TIMING.json](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w14/TIMING.json). The final UI probe ended at 11:52:08.365024 UTC. Subsequent activity only preserved records and prepared this handover.
